role: AI-authored diagnostic hypotheses, not human gold and not final evaluation

author_receipt.action: Author exactly 24 new original public-safe synthetic development messages and all three independent expected semantic states before inference.

semantics.response_requested: An operative request addressed to a reader for an answer or choice. Mere reply mentions and explicitly quoted requests are false.
semantics.current_activity_claimed: An assertion of author activity ongoing at message time. Future, past-only, and negated activity are false.
semantics.completion_claimed: An explicit assertion that a named scope is complete; scoped completion is true even if another scope remains. Future, negated, and remaining-only completion are false.
semantics.unknown: Semantic uncertainty from an underspecified fragment, distinct from an endpoint confidence/margin abstention.
semantics.independence: Each head is interpreted independently; multiple positive heads may coexist. These definitions and all expected states are diagnostic hypotheses.
